newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Bolivian peasants to block roads to protest bill.
newsitem.headline: Bolivian peasants to block roads to protest bill.

text.p: Bolivian peasant and farming groups called on Friday for more protests including road blocks against government plans for a proposed new land law allowing the state to seize property.

"We will not betray our members, so we are calling for the protests to be maintained and radicalized," said Roman Loayza, leader of the Confederation of Peasant Workers, who said peasants were breaking off negotiations with the government.
Loayza said the peasants will stage road blocks on the country's main highways.
The peasant chief said that although there had been some progress in talks that lasted until the early hours of Friday morning, the government was still determined to go ahead with its plans.
The government wants to create a land superintendency with powers to seize rural properties.
The confederation has been leading an indefinite general strike since Thursday, but with little impact on business.
